items.regenerationGuidance: Repair the single collar-gripping BLUE arm only: retain its grip on the WHITE collar, then curve that SAME BLUE elbow and BLUE forearm around the bowed WHITE head so the head sits inside BLUE's collar-gripping elbow loop. Do not use the WHITE defender's own sleeve as the choke loop or have two blue hands separately hold collar and white sleeve. Keep the bottom guard, bodies and other limbs unchanged.
items.singleChangeEnglish: Rebuild the selected loop-choke head-and-arm relationship with WHITE as the BOTTOM attacker and BLUE as the TOP kneeling partner. The SAME WHITE arm must grip the BLUE collar and curve its WHITE elbow/forearm around the bowed BLUE head. Place the BLUE head INSIDE that WHITE collar-gripping elbow loop, while the bottom WHITE head stays outside and clearly separate.

nextEdit.reason: 기존 카탈로그는 WHITE bottom 공격자·BLUE top 파트너다. 현 v2는 BLUE top이 WHITE bottom 깃을 잡고 WHITE 팔 루프에는 WHITE 자신의 머리가 들어가, 포획 머리와 공격 팔의 관계 자체가 달라졌다. 같은 잘못된 머리·팔 배치를 다시 국소 편집하기보다 정확한 기존 포즈와 중립 스타일로 재구성한다.
nextEdit.singleChangeEnglish: Rebuild the selected loop-choke head-and-arm relationship with WHITE as the BOTTOM attacker and BLUE as the TOP kneeling partner. The SAME WHITE arm must grip the BLUE collar and curve its WHITE elbow/forearm around the bowed BLUE head. Place the BLUE head INSIDE that WHITE collar-gripping elbow loop, while the bottom WHITE head stays outside and clearly separate.

references.limitation: 기존 카탈로그 정지 그림만 대조했다. 강사의 직접 영상이나 실제 피니시 효과를 검증한 근거로 취급하지 않는다.

nextEdit.correctionPromptEnglish: Reference 1 is the PRIMARY POSE. The final neutral portrait is for fictional identities and rendering only. Faithfully redraw the catalog's complete body relationship and camera with WHITE as the bottom attacker at viewer right and BLUE as the top kneeling partner at viewer left. WHITE retains the BLUE collar with ONE WHITE hand. That SAME collar-gripping WHITE arm curves its elbow and forearm around the bowed BLUE head so the BLUE head sits INSIDE the WHITE elbow loop. WHITE's other arm supports this same loop connection. Keep WHITE's own head outside the loop, clearly separate at viewer right. Do not put WHITE's own head inside WHITE's sleeve loop, and do not make BLUE's top hands hold the white collar as the choke. Keep exactly two WHITE guard legs attached to the bottom WHITE hips and exactly two BLUE base legs attached to the top BLUE hips. Output one square 1:1 raster image at 1024×1024 or larger with a true transparent alpha background. Preserve these same two fictional adult male characters, their faces and hair, the approved detailed 2.5D anime rendering and brown belts. Black-haired adult owns a complete WHITE gi; white-haired adult owns a complete BLUE gi. Exactly two arms and two legs per person. No text, labels, arrows, panels, floor, matte, checkerboard or watermark.
